newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates close steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates close steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Sunday on low demand by spinners due to a liquidity crunch, brokers said.
Rates were almost steady in lacklustre trading in the absence of exporters who stayed out becauseof high domestic cotton prices. "Cotton rates will open stable on Monday," broker Nasim Usman said.
In the kerb market, the rates for NIAB-78 variety fluctuated between 2,350 and 2,375 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), he said.
High rates were favourable to spinners because of good yarn prices abroad, but not to cotton exporters, Usman said.
